_meta.description: Development threads — the project's long-running lines of work, tracked as first-class rows. Rendered at /threads in the encyclopedia; git activity is matched live via each thread's regex patterns. Seeded 2026-07-13 from the four-month blog synthesis; deepened same day from doc/plans, doc/book/STATE.md, doc/reports, memory, the pipeline scorer, and the uncommitted working tree. Hand-edit freely: progress numbers, open items, and match patterns are all data.

threads.title: The Edge (autogenerated ↔ composed)
threads.summary: The named finish line (Palle, 2026-07-13): the right edge between what the generators produce and what the author composes. Desktop walks already show the gap — the world 'is not really there' — so the missing piece is not observation but a look-contract: rulings on the look, judged in language over captures, compiled back into the generators (staging DNA, rule box, gallery genomes). The craft coefficient measured this residue for ordering; the spatial equivalent has no RULINGS file yet. If the look of the organization lands, the project tips over the edge — and proves language + observation can do the whole work.

Define the authorship loci by contract: where the hand enters (heroes, thresholds, the 2-3 dramatic placements per map); the generator fills the rest — materialized as /template-maps (P-7): the template IS the contract
Show the seam of authorship: make the hand/machine edge legible in-world rather than faking composedness — bias is conserved
Pins (L-011): look_scripts carry pins — artifacts flagged into a map by name, never dropped by the composer
Forward transform + 2D editor (L-011): tools/desire_timeline.py reads maps into eye/hand desire curves; /desire-timeline overlays variants and saves editable targets
Inverse transform: script_compose scores candidates against saved desire targets (doc/book/look_scripts/desire_targets/) — the curve editor becomes the fitness target

Cycle-completion score (L-012/P-3): join ride log with staging types — promises consummated in their artifact's currency (touch reach for instruments, dwell pockets for performers), unconsummated promises declared as blanks; typed events in the /desire-timeline score
Space ⇄ time unified editor (L-016/P-5): /space-time — plan and filmstrip as one draggable object; saves sibling maps; dwell declarations write back

The marriage (map_tournament.py): all 14 pearl-factory strategies judged by the experience fitness — first leaderboard: halls 6.63 > ants > rooms; flock/lsystem bottom. Next: per-sequence tournaments + desire targets as the prize

Text as the score's clock (L-017/P-6): full compiler text -> segments -> modality/load/emphasis -> desire target + script; pilot done (reading-dwell from tutorial.md, modality-overload flag); next: segment the walls, wire walked.md emphasis to hero/axis
